method: White page backgrounds with dark lacquer cards; cards resized to poker size (63 x 88 mm), nine per sheet with shared cut lines, larger undimmed character art (user request). findings: 24 A4 pages: 16 reference and mat pages on white, 6 sheets of nine poker-size cards, offer slips and markers.
Cards keep the dark browser style; character pictures are larger and no longer dimmed.
Neighbouring cards share a cut line; assembly page explains one cut separates two cards.

previousReview.method: Dark Khmer-theme redesign of every page (user request: match the live browser design). Agent rendered all 31 master pages at 120 dpi and inspected them at readable size in groups of four; the 40 dpi overview of all pages was also reviewed. The integration verifier checks that every extracted page is pixel-identical to its master page.
findings: Page 19 PoLong cards now use the user-supplied portrait (assets/art/newpolong.jpg); page 19 re-rendered at 90 dpi and inspected. All other pages are unchanged from the prior inspected build.
All pages use the near-black background, bronze frames and lines, bone text, Battambang headings and Kantumruy Pro body text.
Cut cards: dark lacquer, bronze cut border with inner frame, art in a temple-arch frame with a lotus finial; identities, IDs and gameplay text unchanged and readable.
Writing areas (workshop record fields, dashboard counters, offer-slip checkboxes) are parchment so pencil stays legible.
Cover adds the reaper ferryman vector from the browser and a lotus rule; the 50 mm calibration line is unchanged.
Minor: the "instance: ____" blank on the two PoLong templates is on dark card, so pencil there is low contrast.
limitations: Digital inspection only; dark full-page printing uses heavy ink, and printed color, dark-art detail, scale and handling need a person.
Rules text, card geometry and component counts were not changed.
